answer: Inter-arrival jitter fingerprinting. Each identity must submit its first N transactions with inter-arrival gaps matching a per-identity jitter profile seeded at registration, verified against a cedar-keyed schedule the agent cannot see. Identities launched in bursts (shared clock or script) fail the zenith tolerance band and get throttled to one action per epoch. Honest agents pay only a short warm-up delay; a sybil farm must harbor each fake identity on independent randomized timers, multiplying orchestration cost and wall-clock time per identity.
